show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: John Pfeffer - Crypto for Institutions (Capital Allocators, EP.54)
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. In the 2000s, John was a member at private equity firm KKR, and then in the 1990s, he was chairman
of the executive board of leading French IT company Group Alium S.A. The advantage of starting things from scratch is you get to stage your capital
at risk.
